title: Vehicles + TruckExpense CRUD API with expense replacement
description: Implement full CRUD for vehicles: create (requires valid carrierId), list (paginated with carrierId filter), update, soft-delete with active load constraint. PATCH accepts an expenses array that replaces all TruckExpense rows for the vehicle (delete-and-recreate pattern within a transaction). Expenses use the ExpenseCategory enum (FIXED, VARIABLE, SERVICE, WAGE, DEDUCTION) with vehicleId+expenseKey unique constraint. Note: CONCERNS.md flags dispatch-api has no lint command — validationCommand excludes lint.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/vehicles returns 201 with vehicle data including generated UUID id
POST requires carrierId referencing an active carrier; validates type is valid EquipmentType enum (DRY_VAN, REEFER, FLATBED, STEP_DECK, BOX_TRUCK, HOTSHOT, POWER_ONLY)

POST accepts all Vehicle model fields: unitNumber, type, ownership (OWNED/LEASED, default OWNED), year, make, model, vin, licensePlate, licensePlateState, emergencyContactName, emergencyContactPhone, warrantyInfo, monthlyGrossTarget, monthlyMilesTarget, workingDaysPerMonth (default 22), notes
GET /api/v1/vehicles returns paginated list with default limit 25; supports ?carrierId= filter, ?search= (matches unitNumber, make, model), ?sort=&order=
GET list response includes expenses array (all TruckExpense rows) for each vehicle
PATCH /api/v1/vehicles/:id accepts optional expenses array; when provided, replaces all existing TruckExpense rows in a Prisma transaction (deleteMany + createMany)
Each expense object requires: category (ExpenseCategory), expenseKey (string, unique per vehicle), label (string), monthlyAmount (Decimal, default 0)
Expense replacement enforces @@unique([vehicleId, expenseKey]) — returns 400 if duplicate expenseKeys in the same request
Soft delete sets deletedAt; returns 409 ConflictError with blocking load IDs if vehicle assigned to load with status before DELIVERED
All list queries filter WHERE deletedAt IS NULL
All endpoints require auth middleware; vehicle scoped to org via carrier.managedByOrgId
Entity IDs use uuid format (per cross-feature decision L-009)
contractReference: paths./vehicles, paths./vehicles/{vehicleId}, components/schemas/Vehicle, components/schemas/VehicleListItem, components/schemas/TruckExpense, components/schemas/TruckExpenseInput
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest && npx tsc --noEmit
